terms.gloss: I’ll see you there (where you will be)
terms.comment: Cicero to Varro, arranging to come to him: istīc is the place where the person spoken to is or will be.

terms.gloss: I’ll see you there (at the place just named)
terms.comment: A plain sentence of ours for a place both have just agreed on, where neither is yet.

phrases.latin: mihi sī spatium fuerit in Tusculānum ante Nōnās veniendī, istīc tē vidēbō
phrases.english: if I have time to come to Tusculum before the Nones, I’ll see you there

phrases.latin: Ad pontem ergō; ibi tē opperiar.
phrases.english: At the bridge, then; I’ll wait for you there.
